# OpenProgram 0.8.2 Release Notes

OpenProgram 0.8.2 improves long conversation loading and isolates browser previews by conversation.

## Fixes and improvements

- Conversation history loads recent messages first and retrieves earlier messages on demand, retaining branch identity and live message ordering.
- Large history and graph responses use bounded WebSocket fragments without increasing the 4 MiB sender queue or discarding stored content.
- Long conversation graphs use iterative traversal and avoid repeated ancestor scans. Session and branch loading keep expensive projection work off the WebSocket event loop.
- Browser previews remain attached to their conversation when switching chats. Private pages are inaccessible to other agents until explicitly opened as a standalone tab; exclusive control still applies.

## Download and upgrade

Choose the Desktop installer or managed runtime matching your operating system and architecture from the release assets. CLI and Server users can run `openprogram upgrade`. Desktop users can replace the installed application with the matching installer.

Stored conversations and configuration under `~/.openprogram` are preserved. This release does not change model context compaction or delete conversation history. Full graph construction and initial session indexing still use resources proportional to session size.
